tools.name: progenda_list_centers
tools.description: List the centers (practices) your Progenda user can access. Start here: the center id is needed by the patient tools. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/centers.

tools.name: progenda_list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars (one agenda per practitioner) your Progenda user can access. The calendar id is needed by the appointment and service tools. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/calendars.

tools.name: progenda_list_patients
tools.description: List the patients of a center, 1000 per page. Contains personal and health-adjacent data: fetch only what the user asks for. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/centers/{center_id}/patients.

tools.name: progenda_get_patient
tools.description: Get one patient by your own remote_id. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/centers/{center_id}/patients/remote_id:{remote_id}.

tools.name: progenda_list_appointments
tools.description: List the appointments of one calendar, optionally between two Unix times (start, stop) or updated since a time. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/calendars/{calendar_id}/appointments.

tools.name: progenda_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by your own remote_id. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/calendars/{calendar_id}/appointments/remote_id:{remote_id}.

tools.name: progenda_list_services
tools.description: List the services (appointment types) of one calendar. The service remote_id is used when you create an appointment. Progenda API: GET /api/v2/calendars/{calendar_id}/services.

tools.name: progenda_get_suggestions
tools.description: Compute suggested free slots in one calendar for one service. Live route: GET /api/v2/calendars/{calendar_id}/suggestions?service_id= (the route named in the docs answers 404).

tools.name: progenda_create_patient
tools.description: Create a patient in a center under your own remote_id. Creates a new record each time it runs with a new remote_id; use progenda_update_patient to change an existing one. Progenda API: POST /api/v2/centers/{center_id}/patients.

tools.name: progenda_update_patient
tools.description: Update a patient found by your own remote_id. The four contact fields are required by the API: send the current values for the ones you do not change. Progenda API: PUT /api/v2/centers/{center_id}/patients/remote_id:{remote_id}.

tools.name: progenda_create_appointment
tools.description: Create an appointment in a calendar under your own remote_id, for a patient remote_id and a service remote_id. Each run creates a new appointment. Progenda API: POST /api/v2/calendars/{calendar_id}/appointments.

tools.name: progenda_update_appointment
tools.description: Change an appointment found by your remote_id: time, status (booked, cancelled, noshow), arrival or no-show. Send only the fields to change. Progenda API: PUT /api/v2/calendars/{calendar_id}/appointments/remote_id:{remote_id}.
